Title: Barcelona win 11th consecutive match
Text: Hansi Flick's side remain perfect across all competitions this season.

Title: 🔴🔵 BRAVE. CONFIDENT. TOGETHER.
Text: Hansi Flick on whether PSG is an early final or a major test: “It will be a good test for us to see where we stand. I want my team to play with confidence, bravery and togetherness, just as we’ve done in recent matches.” “We’re facing arguably the best team in the world over the last two years. It’s a great opportunity to show our level and see what we can improve. After the match, we’ll know a lot more.”
